messages:
maria_support: Heads-up — received a customer escalation: EU tenant-eu-42 is seeing requests served from us-east with higher latency and a data-residency alert in their audit logs. Request IDs: r-3421a, r-3421b. Anyone seeing a routing fallback?

alex_oncall: Looking. Any error codes? Customer says API returns 200 but x-region header shows us-east-1 and compliance-bot fired.

sam_network: We had an automated failover last night during a GCE outage. Fallback routing may have used the global pool. Investigating routing policy: fallback.strategy=regional->global? There was a canary rolled yesterday night.

ingrid_prodops: Is this causing auth or billing issues? Need to know if PII left the EU. @compliance-bot can you post the alert details?

compliance-bot: ALERT: policy=data_residency_violation severity=high
Affected tenant: tenant-eu-42
Triggered on route: /v1/generate
Audit link: https://redwood.ai/audit/alert/8271
Notes: Data left EU region during failover. Exception flagged by retention_policy 'eu_only'.

jess_billing: Customer also reported a cost spike. Requests hitting us-east incur a different pricing tier. We need immediate rollback of cross-region fallback for regulated tenants.

alex_oncall: OK. Sam, can you confirm which autoscaler/failover change rolled out? @deploy-bot who deployed the canary yesterday?

deploy-bot: deploy: service=routing-control sha=ab12c3 env=prod time=2026-02-18T03:12Z

sam_network: That canary included a change: 'global_fallback_enabled=true' for zones without capacity. Should have been gated. Looks like the feature flag didn't respect tenant residency tag. Reproducing locally.

maria_support: Sending repro to customer: 
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-Target-Region: eu-west-1' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
They included response headers:
```
HTTP/2 200
x-region: us-east-1
x-request-id: r-3421a
x-audit: data_residency_violation
```
No 403, so app layer allowed it but audit flagged it.

alex_oncall: Capture traces: use trace id r-3421a. @ingrid_prodops can you pull route decision logs for that request id? Also blacklist global_fallback for tenants with tag 'eu_restricted'.

ingrid_prodops: Pulled logs: route_decision: preferred=eu-west-1 capacity=0 fallback=global-us-east pool=global-us-east reason='capacity_exhaustion'
Policy eval: residency_tag=eu_restricted -> exception raised at 03:12:45Z
I will patch routing-control to honor residency tag and deploy hotfix.

sam_network: Hotfix plan: 1) toggle global_fallback_enabled=false for EU-region tenant class 2) roll forward policy to deny cross-region routing for tagged tenants 3) backfill audit: mark all requests in window 02:55-03:25 as residency-exemptions and notify customers.

jess_billing: Need to create credit for affected customers. I'll open billing ticket. @maria_support gather affected tenants list.

maria_support: On it. Also advising customer to rotate keys if they consider this data exposure. They asked for ETA.

alex_oncall: ETA for hotfix deploy is ~15 min. After deploy we will re-run a synthetic test:
```
curl -i -H 'X-Target-Region: eu-west-1' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Expect x-region: eu-west-1 and no audit flag.

compliance-bot: Audit update: flag_count +1 for tenant-eu-42. Compliance team notified: #legal already pinged.

jess_billing: :white_check_mark: Billing ticket created BH-5478. Tagging for credits and rate history.

maria_support: Customer replied: they're okay with rollback fix, want written timeline for audit. I'll draft an escalation summary.

alex_oncall: After hotfix, we'll run a 5-minute sweep across recent requests to ensure no other cross-region incidents. Also add a test to CI to ensure residency tags are enforced even during failover.

sam_network: Root cause: canary + missing residency guard in fallback logic. I'll add guard and feature-flag default-off. Postmortem to follow.

ingrid_prodops: Hotfix pushed and verified. Post-deploy check: synthetic passed, x-region eu-west-1 for test request. Marking incident as active->investigation->mitigated.

maria_support: :thumbsup: I'll send summary and the audit link to customer with timeframe and credits info.
